component.name: Gosh Yubico Authenticator
component.summary: Manage OATH credentials on YubiKey devices

description.p: Gosh Yubico Authenticator is a native Qt 6 / Kirigami desktop application for managing OATH (TOTP and HOTP) credentials stored on YubiKey devices. It is built with KDE Frameworks 6 and integrates naturally with Plasma and other desktops.
This independent application is not affiliated with or endorsed by Yubico.

ul.li: Generate TOTP and HOTP codes from credentials on the key
Add credentials from a secret, an otpauth link, or by scanning a QR image
Open QR images straight from network shares
Protect the key with an OATH password and require touch when needed
Copy codes to the clipboard with automatic clearing
Follow the system color scheme, or force light or dark

description.p: The Flatpak talks to the host PC/SC daemon. Install and start pcscd on the host before inserting a YubiKey.
Complete rewrite as a native Qt 6 / Kirigami (KDE Frameworks 6) application.

ul.li: Native KDE look and feel with system, light, and dark color schemes
QR images can now be opened directly from network shares
All GTK 4 / libadwaita code and dependencies removed

description.p: Fail closed on malformed OATH device identity data and tighten Flatpak permissions.
Native GTK 4 / Adwaita rewrite with Flatpak packaging.
